content:
The leaf shows a dark, sooty coating across most of the surface with irregular dark patches and spots. The coloration is a greenish-black, consistent with a fungal growth overlaying the leaf surface. There is no typical necrotic lesion pattern (ruling out Anthracnose), no white powdery coating (ruling out Powdery Mildew), and no tip/branch dieback. The dark, smudgy, coal-like coating uniformly covering the leaf surface is characteristic of Sooty Mould.
